text: Implemented shared checked orbit/reset actions without perturbing exact canonical RAS viewpoints; linked bilateral camera navigation; explicit bilateral JavaFX group placement; disposable mouse/scroll/keyboard controller; 30 Hz hover throttle; PickResult node/local-face recovery to original FaceId, barycentrics, nearest VertexId, and shared selection/readouts; graphics Scene selection chrome; interaction receipts with upload and p50/p95 timing. Shared core passes JVM/JS including both-hemisphere lateral/medial and A/P/D/V contracts. Live PickResult agrees with raster oracle at face 0/vertex 0; 60 orbit steps retain only initial mesh/atlas uploads, navigation p95 0.165917 ms, pick 1.010375 ms. Independent per-panel bilateral cameras are not part of this linked-camera implementation and can be added without changing the shared renderer contract.
